metadata.title: Mean curvature flows with cylindrical singularities II: stability and genericity
metadata.abstract: In [SX25], we introduced the notion of nondegenerate cylindrical singularity using the ideas from dynamical systems. In this paper, we further study the properties of these singularities, showing that they are stable under small perturbations. Furthermore, we show that we can perturb some mean curvature flow with degenerate singularities to produce nondegenerate singularities.
metadata.comment: 30 Pages. This is the second part of ver 1 of https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.00419v1 , with more details. Much progress has been made on this problem since 2022, and it is hard for us to keep track of it all; to reflect the original ideas in this work, we decided to keep our original references

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明非退化圆柱型平均曲率流奇点在小扰动下稳定，并把部分退化奇点扰动成非退化奇点。
analysis.breakthrough: 推进圆柱奇点的稳定性与泛性理论。
analysis.limitations: 作者说明这是2022年旧预印本第二部分的细化拆分，保留原参考文献；不能将全部内容视为今日首次出现，也不能把部分可扰动性说成完全泛性。 数学分析仅依据摘要及评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
